flowering.description: Wheat at flowering stage is most sensitive to heat. Pollen viability drops sharply above 35°C.

grain_fill.description: High temps during grain fill reduce kernel weight and protein content.

vegetative.description: Wheat is relatively tolerant in vegetative stage but prolonged heat causes leaf rolling.

transplanting.description: Young rice plants need consistent moisture and mild temperatures to establish roots.

flowering.description: Even one day above 35°C during rice flowering can cause spikelet sterility.

grain_fill.description: Chalky grains and reduced milling quality result from heat stress during grain fill.

tasseling.description: Maize tasseling is the most heat-sensitive stage. Silk drying causes pollination failure.

vegetative.description: Maize is reasonably heat tolerant in early vegetative stages.

grain_fill.description: Extended heat during grain fill reduces starch accumulation and final yield.

flowering.description: Cotton flower bud (square) shedding increases above 38°C, reducing boll set.

boll_development.description: Boll development needs consistent moisture. Stress causes premature boll opening.
